import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int v;
        long c;
        long w;
        int r;

        Edge(int v, long c, long w, int r) {
            this.v = v;
            this.c = c;
            this.w = w;
            this.r = r;
        }
    }

    static class MinCostFlow {
        List<List<Edge>> G;

        MinCostFlow(int n) {
            G = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                G.add(new ArrayList<>());
            }
        }

        void add(int u, int v, long c, long w) {
            int i = G.get(u).size();
            int j = G.get(v).size();
            G.get(u).add(new Edge(v, c, w, j));
            G.get(v).add(new Edge(u, 0, -w, i));
        }

        long run(int s, int t, long f) {
            int N = G.size();
            long res = 0;
            long[] H = new long[N];
            long[] D = new long[N];
            final long INF = (long) 1e18;
            int[] PE = new int[N], PV = new int[N];

            PriorityQueue<long[]> q = new PriorityQueue<>(Comparator.comparingLong(a -> -a[0]));
            while (f > 0) {
                Arrays.fill(D, INF);
                D[s] = 0;
                q.clear();
                q.offer(new long[]{0, s});
                while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                    long[] top = q.poll();
                    long d = -top[0];
                    int u = (int) top[1];
                    if (D[u] < d) continue;
                    for (int i = 0; i < G.get(u).size(); i++) {
                        Edge e = G.get(u).get(i);
                        if (e.c > 0 && D[e.v] > D[u] + e.w + H[u] - H[e.v]) {
                            D[e.v] = D[u] + e.w + H[u] - H[e.v];
                            q.offer(new long[]{-D[e.v], e.v});
                            PV[e.v] = u;
                            PE[e.v] = i;
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (D[t] == INF) return -1;
                for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) H[i] += D[i];
                long d = f;
                for (int i = t; i != s; i = PV[i]) {
                    d = Math.min(d, G.get(PV[i]).get(PE[i]).c);
                }
                f -= d;
                res += d * H[t];
                for (int i = t; i != s; i = PV[i]) {
                    Edge e = G.get(PV[i]).get(PE[i]);
                    e.c -= d;
                    G.get(i).get(e.r).c += d;
                }
            }
            return res;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long N = sc.nextLong();
        long M = sc.nextLong();
        long K = sc.nextLong();
        long C = sc.nextLong();
        long D = sc.nextLong();

        int[] A = new int[(int) K];
        for (int i = 0; i < K; i++) {
            A[i] = sc.nextInt() - 1;
        }

        int[] us = new int[(int) M];
        int[] vs = new int[(int) M];
        for (int i = 0; i < M; i++) {
            us[i] = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            vs[i] = sc.nextInt() - 1;
        }

        int size = (int) (N * 101 + 2);
        MinCostFlow mcf = new MinCostFlow(size);
        int s = size - 2;
        int t = size - 1;

        for (int i = 0; i < K; i++) {
            mcf.add(s, A[i], 1, 0);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i <= 100; i++) {
            mcf.add(N * i, t, K, C * i);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                mcf.add(i * (int) N + j, (i + 1) * (int) N + j, K, 0);
            }
            for (int j = 0; j < M; j++) {
                for (int k = 1; k <= K; k++) {
                    long cost = (2 * k - 1) * D;
                    mcf.add((int) (N * i + us[j]), (int) ((i + 1) * N + vs[j]), 1, cost);
                    mcf.add((int) (N * i + vs[j]), (int) ((i + 1) * N + us[j]), 1, cost);
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(mcf.run(s, t, K));
        sc.close();
    }
}
